stem: In paragraph 9 of the excerpt from the article “Millennials. . . So Happy Together,” why does the author point out the difference in how Gen-X and Millennial children were parented?
instruction: Use “Millennials. . . So Happy Together” to answer the following question.

options.label: A
options.text: To explain why Millennials want the convenience of working any time of day or night

options.label: B
options.text: To examine why Millennials seek more dependent and supervised work and living spaces

options.label: C
options.text: To question why Millennials do not mind community policing in either work or living spaces

options.label: D
options.text: To understand why Millennials prefer a safety net in case they cannot achieve their goals
